sloka: शूराः च बलवन्तः च वरुणस्य सुता रणे ।निर्जितास् ते महाबाग चतुर् विध बल अनुगाः ॥६-७-१२॥।।
transliteration: śūrāḥ ca balavantaḥ ca varuṇasya sutā raṇe ।nirjitās te mahābāga catur vidha bala anugāḥ ॥6-7-12॥।।

translations.english: "The mighty and strong Danava warriors who had obtained boon were made to fight a war by you for one year."
translations.hindi: हे राक्षसराज ! बहुत माया जानने वाले महाबली लोकपालों को तुमने युद्ध में जीता
